subject.title: Feature: Per-mention model routing + context window for group mentions

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class mention-state group model routing, and should that behavior be WhatsApp-specific config or a generic channel/plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The feature changes public config, model/provider routing, and what unmentioned group content may be sent to a model, so automation should not choose the privacy and ownership contract.

options.title: Design a generic channel contract
options.body: Define mention-state routing and context sizing across channel/plugin boundaries with explicit provider precedence and privacy rules before coding.

options.title: Add narrow WhatsApp knobs
options.body: Implement mentionModel, backgroundModel, and mentionContextMessages only for WhatsApp, accepting faster delivery with more channel-specific config debt.

options.title: Fold into contextual activation
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38349 or a successor own the broader group-attention design if maintainers want one state-machine solution instead of a narrow routing feature.

recommendation.title: Design a generic channel contract
recommendation.body: Define mention-state routing and context sizing across channel/plugin boundaries with explicit provider precedence and privacy rules before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from recent WhatsApp/config history and prior review of this exact issue.
